atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
rangeLen = input(30, "Range Coil Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Length", 3, 60, 1)
coilThresh = input(0.75, "Coil Load Threshold", 0.1, 0.95, 0.05)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Lookback", 3, 60, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.2, "Release Multiplier", 0.5, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
trMax1 = max(tr1, tr2)
tr = max(trMax1, tr3)
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
rngSafe = max(rng, 0.0001)
highestRng = highest(rng, rangeLen)
highestAtr = highest(atrVal, rangeLen)
compR = 1 - rngSafe / max(highestRng, 0.0001)
compA = 1 - atrVal / max(highestAtr, 0.0001)
coilLoad = (compR + compA) / 2

atrAvg = sma(atrVal, vovLen)
atrSd = stdev(atrVal, vovLen)
vov = atrSd / max(atrAvg, 0.0001)
vovRising = vov > vov[1]

eff = abs(close - open) / rngSafe
effClip = min(max(eff, 0.0), 2.0)
predNorm = sma(effClip, predLen)
predNorm2 = min(max(predNorm, 0.0), 1.0)

releaseE = rngSafe / max(atrVal, 0.0001)
releaseCross = releaseE > releaseMult and releaseE[1] <= releaseMult

isLoaded = coilLoad > coilThresh
isPred = predNorm2 > 0.5
buySig = isLoaded and vovRising and releaseCross and close > open
sellSig = isLoaded and vovRising and releaseCross and close < open
loadedEvent = coilLoad > coilThresh and coilLoad[1] <= coilThresh and vovRising

coilBasePred = isPred ? coilLoad : coilLoad * 0.2
coilBaseUnpred = isPred ? coilLoad * 0.2 : coilLoad
drift = bar_index * 0.00001 + close * 0.000001
coilPredDisp = coilBasePred + predNorm2 * 0.03 + drift
coilUnpredDisp = coilBaseUnpred + (1 - predNorm2) * 0.03 + drift

if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if loadedEvent { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Coil Loaded", "diamond", "#ffd43b") }

plot(coilPredDisp, "Coil Load Pred", "#ff8c1a", 2, "separate")

sessStart = input(0, "Session Start Hour", 0, 24, 1)
sessEnd = input(24, "Session End Hour", 0, 24, 1)
rangeLen = input(20, "Range Lookback Bars", 5, 200, 1)
structLen = input(10, "Structure Lookback (1h bars)", 2, 100, 1)
confReq = input(2, "Confirmation Bars Required", 1, 10, 1)
stopDist = input(10.0, "Hard Stop Distance (price units)", 0.5, 100.0, 0.5)
minConf = input(60, "Min Confidence to Act", 0, 100, 1)

sessHigh = highest(high, rangeLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, rangeLen)
sessSpan = sessHigh - sessLow
inSession = sessEnd >= sessStart

htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
htfSwingHigh = highest(htfHigh, structLen)
htfSwingLow = lowest(htfLow, structLen)
htfSwingHighPrev = htfSwingHigh[1]
htfSwingLowPrev = htfSwingLow[1]
bullRaw = htfClose > htfSwingHighPrev and htfSwingLow > htfSwingLowPrev
bearRaw = htfClose < htfSwingLowPrev and htfSwingHigh < htfSwingHighPrev
htfRange = htfHigh - htfLow
htfRangePrev = htfHigh[1] - htfLow[1]
expansion = htfRange > htfRangePrev
noConflict = low >= sessLow and high <= sessHigh
upBar = htfClose > htfClose[1]
upBarPrev = htfClose[1] > htfClose[2]
choppy = upBar != upBarPrev
isNeutral = not bullRaw and not bearRaw
chopPenalty = isNeutral or choppy
confRaw = 50 + (expansion ? 20 : 0) + (noConflict ? 15 : 0) - (chopPenalty ? 25 : 0)
conf = confRaw > 100 ? 100 : confRaw < 0 ? 0 : confRaw
confScore = conf / 100
breakLong = crossover(close, sessHigh)
breakShort = crossunder(close, sessLow)

var bullCount = 0.0
var bearCount = 0.0
var longStop = 0.0
var shortStop = 0.0
var inLong = 0.0
var inShort = 0.0

bullCount := bullRaw ? bullCount[1] + 1 : 0
bearCount := bearRaw ? bearCount[1] + 1 : 0
confirmedBull = bullCount >= confReq
confirmedBear = bearCount >= confReq
longEntrySig = breakLong and confirmedBull and conf >= minConf and inSession and inLong == 0
shortEntrySig = breakShort and confirmedBear and conf >= minConf and inSession and inShort == 0
longExitSig = inLong == 1 and (crossunder(close, sessLow) or low <= longStop)
shortExitSig = inShort == 1 and (crossover(close, sessHigh) or high >= shortStop)

if longEntrySig {
    model.confidence(confScore)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    longStop := close - stopDist
    inLong := 1
    inShort := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if shortEntrySig {
    model.confidence(confScore)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    shortStop := close + stopDist
    inShort := 1
    inLong := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if longExitSig {
    model.longExit("siege")
    inLong := 0
    longStop := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "L Exit", "triangledown", "#ffcc00")
}
if shortExitSig {
    model.shortExit("siege")
    inShort := 0
    shortStop := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "S Exit", "triangleup", "#ffcc00")
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

windX = input(1.0, "Wind Dir X", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
windY = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Y", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
windZ = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Z", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
windSpeedIn = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
minSpeed = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 1.0)
maxSpeed = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
baseTail = input(1.0, "Base Tail Length", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
stretchPerKnot = input(0.1, "Stretch Per Knot", 0.0, 1.0, 0.01)
alertDeg = input(30.0, "Direction Change Alert Deg", 1.0, 180.0, 1.0)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

var prevNx = 1.0
var prevNy = 0.0
var prevNz = 0.0

driftX = close - open
driftY = (high - low) * 0.2
driftZ = (close - close[1]) * 2.0
dynX = windX + driftX
dynY = windY + driftY
dynZ = windZ + driftZ
wSpeed = windSpeedIn + (close - open) * 0.5 + change(close) * 0.5

mag = sqrt(dynX * dynX + dynY * dynY + dynZ * dynZ)
isZero = mag < 0.000001
safeMag = mag + 0.000001
rawNx = dynX / safeMag
rawNy = dynY / safeMag
rawNz = dynZ / safeMag
nx = isZero ? prevNx : rawNx
ny = isZero ? prevNy : rawNy
nz = isZero ? prevNz : rawNz

horiz = sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + 0.000000001)
yawRad = atan2(ny, nx)
pitchRad = atan2(nz, horiz)
rollRad = 0.0
yawDeg = yawRad * 57.2958
pitchDeg = pitchRad * 57.2958
rollDeg = 0.0

tailLen = baseTail + stretchPerKnot * wSpeed
span = maxSpeed - minSpeed + 0.000001
tRaw = (wSpeed - minSpeed) / span
tLow = tRaw < 0.0 ? 0.0 : tRaw
tNorm = tLow > 1.0 ? 1.0 : tLow
gradR = 255.0 * tNorm
gradG = 165.0 * tNorm
gradB = 255.0 * (1.0 - tNorm)

dotProd = nx * prevNx + ny * prevNy + nz * prevNz
dotLow = dotProd < -1.0 ? -1.0 : dotProd
dotClamped = dotLow > 1.0 ? 1.0 : dotLow
angRad = acos(dotClamped)
angDeg = angRad * 57.2958

highThresh = maxSpeed * 0.6
lowThresh = minSpeed + span * 0.2
buySig = crossover(wSpeed, highThresh) and pitchRad > 0.0
sellSig = crossunder(wSpeed, lowThresh) and pitchRad < 0.0
dirAlert = angDeg > alertDeg
speedAlertEdge = wSpeed > maxSpeed and wSpeed[1] <= maxSpeed
alertSig = dirAlert or speedAlertEdge

if buySig {
